svg.title: CollisionTable storage
svg.desc: Four nested hash maps keyed fixed entity id -> fixed location -> queried entity id -> set of conflicting locations, built once from the GarageGraph and cached on disk.

g.text: From collision_geometry.hpp/.cpp. The lookup example shows the path through the maps; whether that particular pair conflicts depends on the footprint sizes in `common`, not in the snapshots.

g.text: Nothing is computed geometrically during planning. Query looks up, for a fixed entity type at a fixed pose or edge, the set of poses (or edges) where an entity of the queried type would overlap it. The bool

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: overloads test one location; the others return the whole set.
